profile.name: Mahmoud Hany Mazroa
profile.summary: Passionate Game Developer dedicated to blending technical execution with narrative vision to craft immersive experiences. A collaborative problem-solver skilled in thoughtful level design and rapid prototyping, seeking to build high-quality game systems in a professional studio.

education.degree: Bachelor of Computer and Information Sciences (Digital Multimedia)
education.institution: Ain Shams University and University of East London

internships.title: Unity Developer (Contract)
internships.description: Engineered the core C# gameplay architecture, UI layouts, and meta-progression systems for Cyber Salvage, a commissioned mobile title.

internships.title: Game Developer Trainee
internships.description: Participated in an intensive, full-time 9-month game programming incubator, building full-scale VR/AR and desktop titles using Unity, C#, and .NET.

nodes.title: ESCCTRL
nodes.summary: A moody 2D atmospheric platformer built from scratch using SFML and C++ during an intense 3-day game jam. The main hook combines a shape-shifting mechanic with tight spatial navigation through tricky levels, utilizing deep parallax layering so the environment dynamically reacts to movement.
keyContributions: Programmed core gameplay loops in C++ using the SFML framework, implementing robust object-oriented systems for health, damage, trap triggers, and a dynamic weather/rain controller.
Engineered deep parallax layering for dynamic environment reactions and tuned physics parameters (jump arcs, shape-shifting transitions) to ensure tight spatial navigation.

nodes.title: Subject Null
nodes.summary: A narrative-driven VR puzzle game designed for standalone XR devices. The core gameplay revolves around a dynamic mesh slicing mechanic and swapping between different vision states to solve spatial puzzles. Players navigate through a mysterious, atmospheric facility by viewing the world from totally different perspectives.
keyContributions: Engineered core VR gameplay mechanics using C# and the Meta SDK/OpenXR, specifically building a dynamic runtime mesh slicing system and distinct player vision states.
Designed intricate spatial puzzles and managed project repository workflows utilizing Unity Version Control (UVC) to facilitate rapid, seamless iteration.

nodes.title: VR Wave Shooter
nodes.summary: An intense, wave-based VR shooter optimized to run smoothly on standalone headsets without dropping frames. The gameplay focuses on surviving against an ever-growing swarm of enemies while managing a strict ammo economy, requiring careful shot placement as the rounds progress and chaos escalates.
keyContributions: Developed standalone VR combat mechanics using the XR Interaction Toolkit (XRIT), focusing on optimized draw calls and strict memory management for mobile headset performance.
Scripted scalable C# enemy spawning algorithms and dynamic round progression while balancing a strict ammo economy to drive strategic gameplay.

nodes.title: Cyber Salvage
nodes.summary: A mobile game commissioned by the National Bank of Egypt that mixes arena survival with a financial economy sim. Players jump into the arena to fight and gather resources, then head back to the hub to invest and upgrade a factory using simulated market mechanics. The project successfully transforms financial literacy into a genuinely rewarding gameplay loop.
keyContributions: Architected scalable C# gameplay systems utilizing Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and the Dependency Injection design pattern to decouple components and manage memory efficiently.
Engineered dynamic UI layouts using Unity's UI Toolkit and implemented meta-progression systems to balance the economy across the arena survival and factory management loops.

nodes.title: The Learning Lens
nodes.summary: An educational VR/AR application built to make interactive learning highly engaging. Instead of reading about concepts, students experience virtual hands-on lessons. The architecture requires seamless synchronization between complex live backend data and the interactive Unity frontend to create a cohesive classroom environment.
keyContributions: Led backend development by architecting scalable services with .NET, Entity Framework (EF) Core, and Python to manage complex real-time data synchronization.
Engineered the Unity frontend integration utilizing AR Core, bridging server-side network logic directly with local C# gameplay systems and XR components.
